summary: 17 Education & Technology Group Inc. (NASDAQ: YQ), a Chinese foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, attaching a press release announcing unaudited second-quarter and first-half 2026 results. Q2 net revenues were RMB90.1 million (US$13.3 million) versus RMB25.4 million a year earlier, gross margin 69.2%, and GAAP net income RMB1.1 million; first-half revenue RMB189.5 million with a RMB18.3 million net loss. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory terms are disclosed; this is an ordinary earnings current report, not a special situation.
